as_told.title: Condon wrote the McMahon Act behind UFO secrecy

plain: Edward Condon, a scientist who Michels says later dismissed UFOs entirely, wrote the McMahon Act of 1946, a law on atomic secrecy that Michels calls the precursor to the Atomic Energy Act of 1954. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, across several episodes, and in one credits David Grusch, a witness who testified to Congress, for the idea that the Atomic Energy Commission set up UFO secrecy in 1954. Michels says this means Condon "is basically writing up UFO secrecy before he then debunks the entire thing."
